name: Set GPU Priority for Current Game
description: Increases the GPU task scheduling priority for the current game process, improving frame pacing and stability.
commands:
# --- CONFIG ---
$proc = "GameName.exe"                 # replace with the detected exe
$base = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\$proc"
$path = Join-Path $base "PerfOptions"
New-Item -Path $path -Force | Out-Null
# GpuPriority: higher value favors the process' GPU scheduling
Set-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name "GpuPriority" -Type DWord -Value 8 -Force
revert22H2:
$proc = "GameName.exe"
$path = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\$proc\PerfOptions"
Remove-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name "GpuPriority" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
